newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi, Marubeni win 90 bln yen power plant order.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi, Marubeni win 90 bln yen power plant order.

text.p: Okinawa Electric Power Co said on Friday that it had awarded a 90 billion yen order to build a thermal power plant to Mitsubishi Corp and Marubeni Corp.
Construction of the 440,000 kilowatt (kw), coal-fired powerhouse will start October 1 in Kin, central Okinawa, an Okinawa Electric official said.
One of the two 220,000 kw generators is expected to start commercial operations in May 2001, followed by the start-up of the other unit two years later, he said.
The new plant would be Okinawa's second thermal powerhouse that runs on coal, he added. The electric utility brought its first coal-fired plant on line in 1994.
Okinawa Electric is the only one among Japan's 10 regional power utilities that does not own nuclear power plants.
